agenda_text:
CITY OF LA VERNE
  SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  AGENDA

Terry Kistler, Chair  La Verne Community Center
Bette Donovan, Member  Classroom 1
Edward Padgett, Member  3680 D Street
Scott Snider, Member  La Verne, CA 91750
Jenny Jolly, Member  (909) 596-8776
George Borst, Member
Valarie Ortiz, Member
Yvonne Duran, Staff Liaison
Armando Cisneros, Staff Liaison
Robyn Olsen, Staff Liaison

  Wednesday, November 19, 2025 – 10:00 a.m.
  La Verne Community Center Classroom 1

Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Senior Advisory Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Committee with valuable
information. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the
La Verne Community Center at (909) 596-8776 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Public comments will be allowed near the conclusion of the meeting.

  1. ROLL CALL – Terry Kistler, Bette Donovan, Edward Padgett, Scott Snider, Jenny Jolly,
  George Borst, Valarie Ortiz

  2. PRESENTATIONS – Matt Wien, Superintendent, Bonita Unified School District

  3. APPROVAL OF MINUTES – October 15, 2025

  4. DISCUSSION & ACTION ITEMS
  a. Senior Nutrition Program
  b. Meals on Wheels Program
  c. Bingo Report
  d. Account Balance Update
  e. Monthly Senior Program Fees
  f. Mt. SAC Classes Update
  g. Aging Next
  h. Facilities Report
  i. Upcoming Events
   5. PUBLIC COMMENT
  Public comments will be allowed on items not on the Agenda but within the subject
  matter jurisdiction of the Committee; however, no action may be taken on off-agenda
  items except as provided by law.

  6. STAFF/COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION/INFORMATION

  7. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Senior Advisory Committee will be held at
  10:00 a.m. on January 21, 2026 at the La Verne Community Center, 3680 D Street,
  La Verne CA 91750.

Posting Statement: On November 13, 2025 a true and correct copy of this Notice was posted
on the bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website
at www.laverneca.gov.
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, November 19, 2025

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at:
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, October 15, 2025.

  Members present: Edward Padgett, Bette Donovan, Terry Kistler, George Borst,
  Scott Snider, Valarie Ortiz.

  Members Absent: Jenny Jolly.

  Staff Present: Armando Cisneros, Parks & Recreation Specialist, Robyn
  Olsen, Parks & Recreation Specialist.

  It was moved by Scott Snider and seconded by Edward Padgett to approve the
  minutes of Wednesday, October 15, 2025 meeting. Motion carried.

  Debra Fritz, Deputy City Clerk, read all members the Oath of Office so they can
  be sworn in as official members of the Senior Advisory Committee. The only
  member not sworn in was Jenny Jolly because she was absent from the meeting.

  Unfinished Business

2. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 592 meals were served to an average of 27 participants in
  October.

  Meals on Wheels: No Update.

3. Bingo Report: Bingo is doing well. The average number of members per
  month was steady at 70 participants.

4. Account Balance: $6,074.99.

5. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid except Woodcarvers and Bridge.

6. MT. SAC Classes: Currently in Fall Session. All classes are going well!
 7. Aging Next: No Report. Aging Next is currently going through personnel
  changes.

  New Business

8. Facilities Report: Community Center is still dealing with leaks in the Senior
  Craft room.

9. Upcoming Events

  •  Thursday, November 20th – Senior Thanksgiving Luncheon, 10:00AM.
  •  Monday, November 24th – Friday, November 28th – Thanksgiving Holiday Closure.
  •  Monday, December 1st – Christmas Tree Lighting, 6:00PM.
  •  Thursday, December 4th –Excursion, Christmas with Frank Sinatra and Doris Day, 10:45AM –
  4:45PM.
  •  Saturday, December 6th – Brunch with Santa and Friends, 9:00AM – 11:00AM.
  •  Monday, December 8th – Movie Matinee, A Christmas Story, 12:30PM.
  •  Saturday, December 13th – Winter Wonderland, 9:00AM – 1:00PM.
  •  Tuesday, December 16th – Senior Holiday Luncheon, 10:30AM – 1:00PM.
  •  Thursday, December 18th – Excursion, Christmas on the Coast, 1:30PM – 9:00PM.
  •  Monday, December 22nd – Friday, January 2nd – Holiday Closure, Community Center.

  Public Comments: Scott announced that Hillcrest is having a Cocoa Fun Event on
  Saturday, December 13th from 2:00PM – 4:00PM on the Shuffleboard court at
  Hillcrest.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 11:00AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, January 21, 2026 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Parks & Recreation Specialist
